verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a desktop app on macOS, Windows, and Linux, with tabs added to it. Separately, it advertises multi-session support for running parallel agents on the same project, which covers the multiple-sessions half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows visual diff review in the desktop app, and tabs are not clearly side-by-side views. Missing for 10: visual diff review in the desktop app, documented side-by-side (split) session layout, independent or hands-on confirmation of desktop multi-session use.
